sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: How can two boundary CFTs that appear dynamically decoupled exhibit correlations computed through a connected Euclidean bulk? The wormhole example tests whether a correlated or entangled joint state can account for the bulk prediction.

sources.title: On Non-handlebody Instantons in 3D Gravity

evidence.text: How can non-handlebody hyperbolic instantons contribute to the holomorphically factorized partition function of pure three-dimensional gravity with negative cosmological constant, and what does their degeneration imply for a proposed extremal-CFT dual?

sources.title: Lorentzian AdS, Wormholes and Holography

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian GKPW compute correlators with two independent asymptotic boundaries, and when do mixed-boundary correlations indicate interactions, entanglement, or both?

sources.title: The Factorization Problem in Jackiw-Teitelboim Gravity

evidence.text: Can pure Lorentzian JT gravity define a consistent quantum system while failing the boundary factorization required by AdS/CFT? The paper constructs its physical degrees of freedom, interprets Hartle–Hawking states, and examines how a factorizing microscopic completion changes the picture.

sources.title: No ensemble averaging below the black hole threshold

evidence.text: Can fixed-energy observables in AdS/CFT avoid apparent ensemble averaging despite connected bulk contributions with disconnected boundaries, and can hyperbolic three-manifold geometry establish this in the semiclassical AdS3 setting?

sources.title: Further Evidence Against a Semiclassical Baby Universe in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can the same CFT state consistently encode a semiclassical disconnected baby universe and a bulk without one, while retaining the conventional extrapolate dictionary and causal-wedge encoding?

sources.title: Towards a holographic description of closed universes

evidence.text: Can AS2 baby universes and Maldacena–Maoz closed universes be described by boundary operator algebras and states within AdS/CFT, and can an appropriate large-N limit resolve the apparent absence of a semiclassical baby-universe sector?

sources.title: Baby universes in string theory

evidence.text: What do the O(e^−N) corrections that spoil large-N holomorphic factorization of two-dimensional Yang–Mills mean in the dual black-hole geometry, and can their baby-universe interpretation preserve quantum coherence?

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Compare the radial metric factor with its pure-AdS value pointwise, then test the subtracted radial integral at zero and infinity. The explicit convergence conditions are added in the analytical reconstruction.

sources.title: On Non-handlebody Instantons in 3D Gravity

evidence.text: Uses Dehn's lemma and cutting along embedded discs to reduce compressible boundaries. The surgeries lower genus, disconnect the manifold, or produce a connected manifold with two boundary components, eventually reaching π₁-injective pieces.

sources.title: Lorentzian AdS, Wormholes and Holography

evidence.text: Evaluate the quadratic on-shell action at both boundaries to obtain a 2×2 kernel Δij. These kernels are normal derivatives of bulk–boundary propagators, equivalently double normal derivatives of the bulk Green function. Regulate at finite radial distance, renormalize source data and discard contact terms for separated insertions.

sources.title: The Factorization Problem in Jackiw-Teitelboim Gravity

evidence.text: Evaluate Euclidean disk and cut-disk saddles to obtain semiclassical Hartle–Hawking wave functions in energy and length representations. Boundary corners require different prescriptions for overlap corners, proportional to π−θ, and corners introduced by cutting states, proportional to π/2−θ.

sources.title: No ensemble averaging below the black hole threshold

evidence.text: Use operator-state correspondence and sewing into three-holed spheres to express selected amplitudes through dimensions, spins and trilinear couplings. Pinching a boundary cycle creates a long propagation tube; exponential growth from negative-energy states requires V_R→−∞ at leading semiclassical order.

sources.title: Further Evidence Against a Semiclassical Baby Universe in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Control thermal tails with Markov's inequality, then use Cauchy–Schwarz, Hölder and trace-norm estimates to compare truncated states and swap expectations. Fannes' inequality supplies a separate existence argument for a single-copy distinguishing operator.

sources.title: Do holographic CFT states have unique semiclassical bulk duals?

evidence.text: Can one fixed holographic CFT state have two simple semiclassical bulk descriptions differing by the presence of a closed universe? Which bulk-boundary dictionary and inner product then describe an observer's experience?

sources.title: Partition Functions of Three-Dimensional Pure Gravity

evidence.text: Can genus-two partition functions of extremal CFTs at general c = 24k be constructed consistently and uniquely, and can gravitational instanton sums reproduce them, conditional on those CFTs existing?

sources.title: Product CFTs, gravitational cloning, massive gravitons and the space of gravitational duals

evidence.text: Can AdS/CFT realize interacting theories with multiple gravitons, which gravitons remain massless, and what bulk structures describe large-N CFTs coupled through products of operators?

sources.title: The CFT/AdS correspondence, massive gravitons and a connectivity index conjecture

evidence.text: Which CFTs admit gravitational duals on one asymptotically AdS space, several common-boundary components, or none? How does coupling product CFTs generate graviton masses while preserving overall conformal invariance?

sources.title: Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity with matter, generalized eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, and random matrices

evidence.text: Can JT gravity minimally coupled to a free massive scalar be described by an effective two-matrix ensemble that generalizes ETH, matches gravitational disk correlators, and determines cylinder amplitudes and their UV pathologies?

sources.title: The inside outs of AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$: exact AdS wormholes with entangled CFT duals

evidence.text: Can independent stress-tensor data at two asymptotically AdS3 boundaries be completed into exact geometries with smooth horizons and wormhole interiors, and identified with explicit entangled CFT2 states through observable matching?

sources.title: Restoring unitarity in BTZ black hole

evidence.text: Can a gravitational description of eternal BTZ reproduce finite-volume unitary relaxation and Poincaré recurrences, rather than indefinite quasinormal decay? Does summing semiclassical topologies suffice, or is a nonperturbative modification of the horizon needed?

sources.title: Wormholes, Emergent Gauge Fields, and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How can wormhole-threading bulk Wilson lines be represented in the tensor product of two boundary CFTs, and can resolving this factorization problem motivate charge completeness and a stronger weak gravity conjecture?

evidence.text: Embedding-space coordinates, Schwinger parameters, and harmonic/split representations of bulk propagators organize Witten-diagram calculations. Mellin-Barnes contour pinching identifies exchange and loop poles.

sources.title: Looking for a bulk point

evidence.text: Radial OPE expansions track phases of double-trace dimensions after Lorentzian continuation. For the exact two-dimensional bound, quantization on the pillow T²/Z₂ gives a positive elliptic-nome expansion; Cauchy–Schwarz bounds the Lorentzian answer by a finite Euclidean correlator.

sources.title: A Study of Quantum Field Theories in AdS at Finite Coupling

evidence.text: Use dimensional regularization for the scalar effective potential. For GN, paired Pauli–Villars regulators with shifted masses M±MPV preserve the mass-flipping discrete symmetry; differentiating the free-fermion one-point function fixes the bubble's otherwise undetermined constant at ν=id/2.

sources.title: Self-binding energies in AdS

evidence.text: Analytic radial solutions and integrals use incomplete Beta functions, harmonic numbers, and generalized hypergeometric functions. Generic-mass AdS5 scalar exchange is treated numerically with δ=0, shooting from the smooth center and matching boundary asymptotics.

sources.title: Focusing bounds for CFT correlators and the S-matrix

evidence.text: Use HKLL reconstruction and generalized-free-field oscillators to express the free bulk scalar ANEC as a positive coefficient times ∫du A†A. Null integration eliminates the pair-creation and pair-annihilation terms.

sources.title: Imprints of flat space analyticity in de Sitter S-matrix

destinations.title: Can Mellin amplitudes provide a useful definition of AdS scattering amplitudes, and can their large-variable asymptotics recover the bulk flat-space S-matrix?

Which Lorentzian correlator singularities diagnose a local AdS bulk, how do boundary perturbation theory and the OPE account for them, and which singularities survive string corrections or the exact theory?

How can finite-coupling QFT observables on AdS connect boundary conformal correlators, flat-space scattering and BCFT data, while exposing nonperturbative spectral phenomena through large-N resummation?

How do neutral scalar exchange, including massive scalars and derivative couplings, and quartic contact interactions affect charged-particle self-binding in AdS4 and AdS5, and hence the effective-theory constraints proposed by positive binding?
How are bulk ANEC, gravitational focusing, and causality encoded in the flat-space S-matrix and holographic CFT correlators, and what constraints stronger than causality follow?

How are flat-space amplitude singularities and exchanged-particle masses encoded in the de Sitter S-matrix, and can a suitable limit support a flat-space-like EFT interpretation? Positivity and Swampland constraints motivate the investigation.

For discrete-series bulk fields with integer boundary dimensions, how does Generalised Energy Conservation (GEC) in extended-Poincaré de Sitter scattering relate to boundary conformal anomalies and holographic renormalisability, and which contact interactions satisfy each condition?

Can the ordinary S-matrix of an interacting massless scalar theory in five-dimensional Minkowski spacetime be recovered from timelike-boundary data of a bulk AdS theory in the flat-space limit? The paper emphasizes that the answer depends on what bulk quantization is intended.

sources.title: Holography for inflation using conformal perturbation theory

evidence.text: Apply previously derived tree-level holographic formulae and trace/diffeomorphism Ward identities. Domain-wall/cosmology continuation reverses κ²V and sends q→−iq; its sign selects the Bunch–Davies vacuum. For adjoint SU(N) theories, the parameter continuation is N²→−N².

sources.title: Primordial fluctuations from complex AdS saddle points

evidence.text: Steepest-descent approximations are applied to background and fluctuation path integrals, retaining the perturbation action through quadratic order. Scalar and transverse traceless tensor harmonics on S³ reduce the calculation to complex mode solutions and on-shell boundary actions.

sources.title: Spinors in Supersymmetric dS/CFT

evidence.text: Separate a Grassmann-dependent factor β from a bosonic determinant γ; expand β through quadratic order in λ̃λ before numerical summation. For squashing, γ uses an imported analytic expression previously compared with numerical results.

sources.title: Inflation and the dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Identify the bulk generator of combined time translation and spatial rescaling with boundary dilatations; extend this geometrical identification to nonconformal boundary RG evolution by analogy with holographic flows in AdS.

sources.title: Remark about dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Use the vacuum-independent commutator Green function to propagate boundary data between I− and I+. Combine the resulting bilinear pairing with CPT, then match it to a boundary state inner product.

sources.title: Inflation in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: The holographic arguments use a cutoff thermofield description, bulk propagator estimates, and analytic continuation. Heavy-operator two-point functions are approximated by exp(−mL), with radial spacelike geodesics matched across a transparent wall and continued toward null limits.

sources.title: Nonlinear Laplace equation, de Sitter vacua, and information geometry

evidence.text: What do exact, nonperturbative solutions of critical interacting scalar theories reveal about AdS/CFT, the information geometry of solution moduli, and classical scalar descriptions on de Sitter backgrounds?

sources.title: Cosmological models and renormalization group flow

evidence.text: How do positive-Λ perfect-fluid cosmologies differ in causal structure, and what do their horizons imply for a proposed dS/CFT renormalization group interpretation and covariant entropy bounds?

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can asymptotic symmetries and scalar boundary correlators support a holographic description of de Sitter quantum gravity by a Euclidean CFT, determine its central charge in three dimensions, and explain how bulk time and the two asymptotic boundaries are encoded?

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Can FRW boundary correlators define a quantum theory encompassing multiple dS parents and landscape transitions? The source identifies unknown perturbation boundary conditions, a missing Hilbert-space interpretation, and an unestablished averaging prescription.

sources.title: A Comment on multiple vacua, particle production and the time dependent AdS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: How should Lorentzian AdS/CFT encode multiple natural vacua in time-dependent backgrounds, and how does cosmological particle production relate bulk and boundary in-in versus in-out correlators?

evidence.text: How do horizons, thermodynamics and de Sitter vacuum ambiguities in the AdS bubble of nothing and locally AdS black hole map to their boundary CFT?
